project: SISO - Pipeline Antecipado de NF + Agrupamento
description: Antecipa geracao de NF e agrupamento fase 1 para aprovacao (especialmente OC), posterga lancamento de estoque para 'separado', e adiciona icones de progresso visual. PRD completo em tasks/prd-pipeline-antecipado-nf-agrupamento.md

userStories.title: Create stock-posting-service for propria/OC
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to create a shared stock-posting service that handles posting stock when a pedido reaches 'separado', starting with propria and OC decisoes.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/stock-posting-service.ts with exported function lancarEstoqueParaSeparado(pedidoId: string): Promise<void>
Function fetches pedido from DB: decisao_final, empresa_origem_id, nota_fiscal_id, estoque_lancado
If estoque_lancado is true, skip (idempotency guard) and return early
For decisao_final='propria' or 'oc': get token via getValidTokenByEmpresa(empresa_origem_id), call lancarEstoqueNota(token, nota_fiscal_id) via runWithEmpresa, then set estoque_lancado=true
If nota_fiscal_id is null, log error and return without throwing (fire-and-forget safe)
For decisao_final='transferencia': log a TODO message and return (transferencia support added in US-002)
All errors are logged via logger.logError with category 'external_api' and pedidoId — function never throws
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference src/lib/execution-worker.ts lines ~413-421 for the propria stock posting pattern (lancarEstoqueNota + estoque_lancado update). Import lancarEstoqueNota from src/lib/tiny-api.ts, getValidTokenByEmpresa from src/lib/tiny-oauth.ts, runWithEmpresa from src/lib/tiny-queue.ts, createServiceClient from src/lib/supabase-server.ts. The function must be fire-and-forget safe (never throw, always log). Use the same sleep(500) pattern as the execution worker between API calls.

userStories.title: Add transferencia support to stock-posting-service
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the stock-posting service to handle transferencia pedidos with the correct multi-step stock movement sequence.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/lib/stock-posting-service.ts, implement the transferencia branch (replace the TODO from US-001)
Step 1: lancarEstoqueNota on origin empresa (clears Tiny reservation, drops saldo) — non-fatal, log warning if fails
Step 2: Get origin empresa deposito_id from siso_tiny_connections
Step 3: Get items from siso_pedido_itens where estoque_saida_lancada is null or false
Step 4: Get enriched stock from siso_pedido_item_estoques for the pedido
Step 5: Resolve empresa that covers 100% of items using getOrdemDeducao (same tier logic as execution-worker.ts)
Step 6: For each item — compensate origin (movimentarEstoque tipo='E') then deduct support empresa (movimentarEstoque tipo='S'), mark estoque_saida_lancada=true and empresa_deducao_id
Step 7: Set estoque_lancado=true on pedido after all items processed
If empresa resolution fails or any item fails, log error but do NOT throw — set estoque_lancado=false so retry is possible
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Copy the logic from src/lib/execution-worker.ts executarSaidaTransferencia lines ~685-954. Key imports: movimentarEstoque from tiny-api.ts, getOrdemDeducao and getEmpresaById from grupo-resolver.ts, buscarProdutoPorSku from tiny-api.ts. The function needs access to the origin empresa (pedido.empresa_origem_id) and must resolve which support empresa has stock. Use the same produto_id_na_empresa cache from siso_pedido_item_estoques, with SKU search fallback.

userStories.title: Hook stock posting into concluir + concluir-oc
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the concluir and concluir-oc endpoints to trigger stock posting (fire-and-forget) when pedidos transition to 'separado'.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/app/api/separacao/concluir/route.ts: after pedidos are transitioned to 'separado' (the separados[] array), call lancarEstoqueParaSeparado for each pedido ID — fire-and-forget with .catch logging
In src/app/api/separacao/concluir-oc/route.ts: same pattern — after pedidos become 'separado', call lancarEstoqueParaSeparado for each — fire-and-forget with .catch logging
Stock posting runs AFTER preCriarAgrupamentosEmLote (which already runs fire-and-forget for separados)
The estoque_lancado guard in the service prevents double-posting if worker already posted (transition safety)
Import lancarEstoqueParaSeparado from '@/lib/stock-posting-service'
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: In concluir/route.ts, look for the preCriarAgrupamentosEmLote fire-and-forget call (around line 123). Add the stock posting call right after it, using the same pattern: lancarEstoqueParaSeparado(pedidoId).catch(err => logger.error(...)). In concluir-oc/route.ts, look for the same pattern (around line 309). Both endpoints already have a separados[] array of pedido IDs that just transitioned to 'separado'.

userStories.title: Remove stock posting from execution worker
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove stock posting from executarSaidaPropria and executarSaidaTransferencia since concluir now handles it.
acceptanceCriteria: In executarSaidaPropria: remove the lancarEstoqueNota call (line ~414) and the estoque_lancado update (line ~419-421). Keep NF generation, marcadores, enriquecerDadosNf, and the aguardando_nf -> aguardando_separacao transition

In executarSaidaTransferencia: remove everything from the 'Post stock from NF on origin' section (line ~685) through the stock deduction loop and estoque_lancado update (line ~954). Keep marcadores, NF generation, enriquecerDadosNf, and the aguardando_nf -> aguardando_separacao transition
Update the function docstrings to reflect the new behavior: 'NF generation only, stock posting deferred to separation'
Update the comment at line ~365 from 'propria: marcadores -> gerar NF -> lancar estoque' to 'propria: marcadores -> gerar NF (estoque postergado para separado)'
Update the comment at line ~13 docstring to reflect that stock posting is now deferred for all decisoes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is primarily a deletion story. In executarSaidaPropria (starts ~line 367): keep lines up to and including the NF generation + enriquecerDadosNf + transition, but remove the lancarEstoqueNota block and estoque_lancado update. In executarSaidaTransferencia (starts ~line 648): the function becomes much simpler — just marcadores + NF + enriquecerDadosNf + transition. Remove the entire stock deduction loop (empresa resolution, item loop, movimentarEstoque calls). The concluir endpoints now handle stock posting via stock-posting-service.ts.

userStories.title: Add NF generation to executarMarcadoresOnly
userStories.description: As a developer, I want executarMarcadoresOnly to generate a nota fiscal for OC pedidos at approval time, so the NF is ready before separation.
acceptanceCriteria: In executarMarcadoresOnly (src/lib/execution-worker.ts ~line 542): after inserirMarcadoresTiny, call gerarNotaFiscalPedido to generate NF
Fetch nota_fiscal_id from pedido select (add to the existing .select query at line ~547)
Call gerarNotaFiscalPedido(job.empresa_id, token, job.pedido_id, pedido?.nota_fiscal_id ?? null) — idempotent if NF already exists
After NF generation, call enriquecerDadosNf to populate chave_acesso_nf
Add sleep(500) between marcadores and NF generation (same pattern as executarSaidaPropria)
NF generation happens BEFORE the compra demand resolution and aguardando_compra transition
If NF generation fails, log error but do NOT block the compras flow — pedido still goes to aguardando_compra
Update function docstring and the comment at line ~448 to reflect: 'oc: marcadores + NF, then compras flow'
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference executarSaidaPropria (lines ~386-425) for the NF generation pattern. The key imports are already available in execution-worker.ts: gerarNotaFiscalPedido, enriquecerDadosNf, sleep. The select at line 547 currently fetches 'marcadores, empresa_origem_id' — add 'nota_fiscal_id' to it. The NF generation must happen before the 'if (compraDemandas.length === 0)' check at line 561, so that even OC pedidos that get reclassified to propria already have the NF.

userStories.title: Add agrupamento fase 1 to executarMarcadoresOnly
userStories.description: As a developer, I want executarMarcadoresOnly to create an agrupamento (fase 1) after NF is persisted, so OC pedidos have expedition ready before separation.
acceptanceCriteria: After NF generation + enriquecerDadosNf in executarMarcadoresOnly, verify NF is persisted by re-fetching the pedido and checking nota_fiscal_id IS NOT NULL and chave_acesso_nf IS NOT NULL
If NF is persisted: fire-and-forget create agrupamento — criarAgrupamento(token, [nota_fiscal_id], formaFreteId?), concluirAgrupamento, obterAgrupamento to get expedicao_id
Save agrupamento_expedicao_id and expedicao_id to siso_pedidos
Do NOT fetch etiqueta/ZPL — fase 2 only
If NF is NOT persisted (chave_acesso_nf still null after enriquecerDadosNf), skip agrupamento — do NOT set agrupamento_expedicao_id to 'pending'
Wrap entire agrupamento block in try/catch — log error but never throw, never block compras flow
Add forma_frete_id and forma_envio_id to the pedido select query for agrupamento creation
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference src/lib/agrupamento-service.ts processarPedido function (lines ~232-349) for the agrupamento creation pattern. Key steps: criarAgrupamento with NF ID array → concluirAgrupamento (non-fatal, Mercado Envios may 400) → obterAgrupamento to find expedicao_id → save agrupamento_expedicao_id + expedicao_id. Import criarAgrupamento, concluirAgrupamento, obterAgrupamento from tiny-api.ts. The formaFreteId comes from pedido.forma_frete_id parsed to int. Critical: do NOT use the 'pending' claim pattern from agrupamento-service.ts — this is inline execution, not batch. If chave_acesso_nf is null after enriquecerDadosNf (which fetches NF details from Tiny), it means the NF wasn't fully processed yet — skip agrupamento silently.

userStories.title: Gate agrupamento-service on NF persistence + idempotency
userStories.description: As a developer, I want preCriarAgrupamentosEmLote to check NF persistence before creating agrupamentos and skip pedidos that already have one.
acceptanceCriteria: In the siso_claim_pedidos_para_agrupamento RPC call (or the filter before it): only claim pedidos where nota_fiscal_id IS NOT NULL and chave_acesso_nf IS NOT NULL
In processarPedido: add early return if pedido already has agrupamento_expedicao_id that is NOT null and NOT 'pending' — log 'Agrupamento ja existe, skip' and return
The existing check 'if (!pedido.nota_fiscal_id)' at line 238 stays, but add a similar check for chave_acesso_nf
When a pedido has no chave_acesso_nf, do NOT set agrupamento_expedicao_id to 'pending' — skip silently
The atomic claim RPC should still work for pedidos that need agrupamento (NF persisted but no agrupamento yet)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: In src/lib/agrupamento-service.ts, the main gate is in processarPedido (line ~232). The PedidoClaimed interface (line ~29) already has nota_fiscal_id. Add chave_acesso_nf to the interface and the select in the RPC. For idempotency: check if agrupamento_expedicao_id is already set (not null, not 'pending') before proceeding. The RPC siso_claim_pedidos_para_agrupamento sets agrupamento_expedicao_id='pending' — modify its WHERE clause (in supabase migrations) to also require chave_acesso_nf IS NOT NULL. Or add a filter in the TypeScript layer after the RPC returns.

Remove the kickWorker() call (lines ~200-205) since there is no job to process

If NF is persisted: set status_separacao='aguardando_separacao'
If NF is NOT persisted: set status_separacao='aguardando_nf' as fallback
Keep the existing decisao resolution logic (mesmoGalpao, empresaExecId, decisao_final, separacao_galpao_id) — these are still needed

userStories.notes: In src/lib/compras-release.ts, the main changes are: 1) Remove the fila_execucao insert (lines ~182-197). 2) Remove kickWorker (lines ~200-205). 3) The NF check at lines ~145-159 already checks nota_fiscal_id — extend it to also check chave_acesso_nf (fetch it in the select at line ~87). 4) The update at line ~162 should NOT include the agrupamento/expedicao fields in the update object — they stay as-is. Keep decisao_final and separacao_galpao_id resolution since the separation module needs to know where to route the order. userStories.title: Encaminhar preserves NF clears agrupamento
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the encaminhar endpoint to preserve NF fields but clear agrupamento/expedicao/etiqueta when re-routing a pedido to a different galpao.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/app/api/separacao/encaminhar/route.ts: when updating the pedido's separacao_galpao_id, also clear agrupamento_expedicao_id, expedicao_id, etiqueta_url, etiqueta_zpl, and etiqueta_status
Do NOT clear nota_fiscal_id or chave_acesso_nf — NF is valid regardless of routing
The clear should only happen when separacao_galpao_id actually changes (compare old vs new)
Log that agrupamento/etiqueta were cleared due to re-routing
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: In src/app/api/separacao/encaminhar/route.ts, find the UPDATE on siso_pedidos that sets separacao_galpao_id. Add these nullifications to the update object: agrupamento_expedicao_id: null, expedicao_id: null, etiqueta_url: null, etiqueta_zpl: null, etiqueta_status: null. The NF stays because it was generated on the origin empresa which doesn't change with routing. The agrupamento may be invalid because it references NF/expedition data that may not apply after re-routing.

userStories.title: Create PipelineIcons component
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a PipelineIcons component that shows 4 colored status icons (N, A, E, Z) representing the pipeline stages.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/components/separacao/pipeline-icons.tsx

Props: { notaFiscalId: number | null, chaveAcessoNf: string | null, agrupamentoExpedicaoId: string | null, estoqueLancado: boolean, etiquetaZpl: string | null, etiquetaStatus: string | null, status: string }
Render 4 compact icons in a horizontal row: N (NF), A (Agrupamento), E (Estoque), Z (Etiqueta/ZPL)
Each icon has 3 visual states: gray/dim (pending), colored/active (complete), red (error)
N icon: active when notaFiscalId AND chaveAcessoNf are both non-null. Red when status='erro' and NF not persisted
A icon: active when agrupamentoExpedicaoId is non-null and not 'pending'. Red when status='erro', NF persisted, and agrupamento absent
E icon: active when estoqueLancado is true. Red when status='erro' and estoqueLancado is false
Z icon: active when etiquetaZpl is non-null. Red when etiquetaStatus='falhou'
Each icon has a tooltip explaining the state (e.g. 'Nota Fiscal gerada', 'Agrupamento pendente', 'Estoque lancado', 'Etiqueta cacheada')
Styling: small rounded badges with letter, using zinc palette for gray, distinct colors per icon when active (similar to Tiny ERP integration icons), red-500 for error
Icons must be compact — max 20-24px each with 2-4px gap
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference the Tiny ERP screenshot in the PRD for visual inspiration — colored letter badges in a row. Use the project's existing patterns: Tailwind classes directly on elements, dark mode support (dark: prefixes), zinc palette for neutral. Colors suggestion: N=emerald when active, A=blue when active, E=amber/orange when active, Z=violet when active. Gray state: bg-zinc-200 text-zinc-400 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-500. Use title attribute for tooltips (simple, no external lib needed). The component should be a simple function component with no state.

userStories.title: Backfill script for existing OC pedidos
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a script that generates NF + agrupamento for existing OC pedidos that are in aguardando_compra without a nota fiscal.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/backfill-nf-agrupamento-oc.ts (TypeScript, runnable with tsx)
Query siso_pedidos WHERE status_separacao='aguardando_compra' AND nota_fiscal_id IS NULL
For each pedido: get empresa_origem_id, fetch token, generate NF via gerarNotaFiscal, call enriquecerDadosNf
After NF is persisted (re-fetch to verify nota_fiscal_id + chave_acesso_nf): create agrupamento, conclude, save agrupamento_expedicao_id + expedicao_id
Do NOT fetch ZPL/etiqueta (fase 2 only)
Respect rate limiting per empresa using runWithEmpresa
Process pedidos in batches of 5 with 2s delay between batches
Log each pedido: success (NF + agrupamento IDs) or failure (error message)
Log summary at end: total processed, successes, failures
Idempotent: skip pedidos that already have nota_fiscal_id, skip agrupamento if already exists
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference the existing scripts/vincular-nf.ts for patterns on how scripts access Supabase and Tiny API in this project. Use createServiceClient from src/lib/supabase-server.ts for DB, getValidTokenByEmpresa from src/lib/tiny-oauth.ts for tokens. The agrupamento creation follows the same pattern as US-006: criarAgrupamento → concluirAgrupamento → obterAgrupamento → save IDs. Add a shebang and make it runnable with: npx tsx scripts/backfill-nf-agrupamento-oc.ts

acceptanceCriteria: In docs/architecture-and-flows.md: update the 'Order Lifecycle' and 'Separation Flow' sections to reflect that stock posting now happens at 'separado', not at approval
